audit_metadata.title: Master Forensic Technical Audit: GPS-Denied Autonomous UAV Navigation
audit_metadata.audit_scope: Full project history from Milestone 1 to Phase 6B

current_verified_baseline.architecture: Frozen BC Policy (bc_policy_best.pt) + Stateless Clearance Guidance (guidance_controller.py) + Safety Supervisor (dcaut=0.50m)

target_95_percent_performance_status.explanation: No controller in the project history has demonstrated 95% success. The highest verified performance on the canonical development set is 84.0% (42/50, 95% CI: [71.5%, 91.7%]). Reaching a true 95% success probability with 95% confidence would require at least 95 successes in 100 episodes (Wilson CI: [88.8%, 97.8%]) or 950 in 1,000 episodes on unseen seeds, which has not yet been executed.

three_most_critical_verified_blockers.title: Unimplemented Flight Controller Driver
three_most_critical_verified_blockers.description: hardware/fc_adapter.py is a non-functional skeleton/stub. It does not import PyMAVLink or establish serial communication with the RadioLink CrossFlight FC. Command transmission raises PermissionError.
three_most_critical_verified_blockers.impact: Completely blocks any hardware integration or bench testing.

three_most_critical_verified_blockers.title: Total Absence of Charging Station Docking Subsystem
three_most_critical_verified_blockers.description: Docking, visual fiducial detection (AprilTag), precision vertical descent, and mechanical latching are 0% implemented in the codebase. Simulation terminates purely on reaching a mathematical coordinate sphere.
three_most_critical_verified_blockers.impact: Completely blocks the competition objective of autonomous landing and docking.

three_most_critical_verified_blockers.title: Remaining Corridor Standoffs & Untested Aerodynamic Wall Risks
three_most_critical_verified_blockers.description: The policy still exhibits 8/50 development timeouts (mostly at Pillar 3 corner pinches). In physical flight, maneuvering within 0.19m of walls carries severe unmodeled aerodynamic Bernoulli wall attraction risk that could cause real crashes.
three_most_critical_verified_blockers.impact: Limits simulation completion to 84% and presents acute physical crash risk in narrow corridor flight.

hardware_readiness_verdict.hardware_integration_ready: NOT READY — BLOCKED by stub fc_adapter.py and unverified serial protocol
hardware_readiness_verdict.controlled_flight_testing_ready: NOT READY — BLOCKED by missing hardware drivers, manual takeover interlocks, and sensor drivers
hardware_readiness_verdict.autonomous_flight_ready: NOT READY — BLOCKED by sim-to-real physics gaps, absence of localization source, and 84% simulation rate
hardware_readiness_verdict.docking_ready: NOT READY — BLOCKED by 100% absence of docking code, hardware sensors, and landing pad mechanics

held_out_evaluation_status.status: SEALED AND UNTOUCHED for the Phase 6/6A production candidate. Ready for formal Phase 5D / Phase 7 evaluation gate.

highest_value_next_engineering_action: Execute the formal held-out generalization benchmark on sealed seeds 90000..90099 for the Phase 6A candidate while implementing the real PyMAVLink serial driver in hardware/fc_adapter.py for disarmed bench testing.
